drug_class: Tetracyclic antidepressant (noradrenergic and specific serotonergic antidepressant)

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing mirtazapine levels; increases serotonin risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if discontinuing St. John's Wort, monitor for increased mirtazapine effects

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive serotonergic effects increase risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision with close monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor; additive serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase serotonergic activity; mild CYP3A4 induction possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive serotonergic effects; inform prescriber of use

caution_supplements.name: Valerian
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive drowsiness and impaired cognition

caution_supplements.name: Kava
caution_supplements.action: Minimize use; monitor for excessive sedation and hepatic function

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Though mirtazapine is not an MAOI, high tyramine intake with concurrent noradrenergic activity may elevate blood pressure
avoid_foods.action: Limit excessive tyramine intake; monitor blood pressure if consuming large quantities

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase mirtazapine absorption and onset of sedation
caution_foods.action: Take mirtazapine consistently with or without food; be aware of enhanced drowsiness with fatty meals

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid alcohol; warn patients of increased drowsiness, impaired judgment, and motor coordination

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May antagonize sedative effects and increase anxiety or tremor
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; consider reducing caffeine intake if experiencing increased anxiety or sleep disturbance

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome signs (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, dilated pupils) especially when combining with other serotonergic agents. Assess weight gain, metabolic parameters, and sedation levels regularly, as mirtazapine commonly causes significant appetite increase and drowsiness.
